End the race?
This clears the board and takes you back to the settings screen. The board is kept one step back, so it can be brought back from there if you change your mind. If you are in a co-op game you leave it; your partner keeps their board.
Lost the connection to the host
Your board is frozen so it cannot drift away from the host's. Trade new codes to reconnect, or leave co-op and keep playing on your own with the board as it is.
Co-op with a partner
Play with one other person over the internet. No server, nothing to install. The host creates the invite: the host's spoiler and visit-marks setting are used for both of you, the host presses OK Dude for both, and the host's board is the master copy that the joiner's board follows every half second. Your layout, panels, icons and auto-tracking stay your own. You trade two short codes in Discord or any chat.
1 Send this invite code to your partner:
2 Paste the reply code they send back, then connect:
Once connected, load your spoiler and set up as usual and press OK Dude: your partner's board starts with yours. If you already pressed it, they load your board as soon as they connect.
1 Paste the invite code your partner sent you:
2 Send this reply code back to your partner:
Waiting for the host to press Connect…
Partner connected. Your spoiler and visit-marks setting are used for both of you; their layout stays theirs. Press OK Dude when you are ready; if you already have, your partner is loading your board now.
not connected
Works on most home networks. If one of you is on mobile data, a strict work network or a VPN, the direct connection may not go through; try another network.

Spoiler log
Paste the spoiler, or choose the file: an alttpr.com spoiler (Veetorp's randomizer, crosskeys included; the JSON you download from the seed page) or a Door Randomizer spoiler (the text log). Shuffled entrances and dungeon prizes are placed on the maps when you press OK Dude; a seed without entrance shuffle still gets its prizes.
